name: interview-copilot
description: AI interview assistant that runs as a browser-extension widget over web meetings (Google Meet / Teams-web). Interviewer and interviewee modes; pick provider (kiro/claude/cursor) and model.

scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
